title: I am building a competitive strategy game solo with AI and looking for core playtesters
author: adamgolya
selftext:
I am building [Crown Claims](http://thecrownclaims.com), a competitive 1v1 strategy game, almost entirely solo with an AI-first development workflow.

The game itself is not about AI. It is about deterministic battles, positioning, bluffing, reading your opponent and adapting over multiple turns. No dice and no pay to win.

AI has allowed me to build much more than I realistically could alone, from development and iteration to testing ideas and speeding up the whole production process.

Now I am looking for 10–20 core playtesters who enjoy deep competitive strategy and would like to play repeatedly, learn the meta and help shape the balance before launch. (They get all the skins forever :) )

The game is already playable.

If this sounds interesting, comment or DM me and I can send you access.
